caseNameFull: Lerner v. Hynes, Deputy Attorney General of New York and Far Rockaway Nursing Home v. Hynes, Deputy Attorney General of New York

opinions.text: Ct. App. N. Y. Appeal as to first case dismissed for want of jurisdiction. Treating the papers whereon the appeal was taken as a petition for writ of certiorari, certiorari denied. Appeal as to second case dismissed for want of substantial federal question. Reported below: 44 N. Y. 2d 329, 376 N.'E. 2d 1294 (first case); 44 N. Y. 2d 383, 377 N. E. 2d 446 (second case).
